plainLanguage: Section 112 — Compounding penal actions. Provision hii inalinda ushahidi, mashahidi na uadilifu wa judicial proceedings.
meaning: Section 112 should be applied from its exact conduct, knowledge, intent, proceeding-related and exception requirements. The offence title alone is not sufficient to establish liability.
keyPoints: Identify the exact prohibited conduct in the official text.
Prove knowledge, intent, wilfulness or wrongful interference where the provision requires it.
Keep any judicial-proceeding connection, lawful excuse, consent or other qualification in the analysis.

history.summary: Section 112 forms part of Chapter XI — Offences Relating to the Administration of Justice — Penal Code [CAP. 16 R.E. 2022].
notes: Official R.E. 2022 text audited before explanation.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo A
expertPerspectives.view: The provision should be tied to concrete interference with evidence, witnesses or judicial process as its wording requires.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo B
expertPerspectives.view: Where knowledge, intention or wilfulness is expressly required, it must be separately established rather than presumed.

debateQuestion: Je, evidence inathibitisha kila statutory element ya section 112?
disclaimer: Ufafanuzi huu si maandishi rasmi ya sheria.
